[[Taameh's Scythe]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[scythe]] dropped [[Taameh the Frigid]], a [[boss]] in [[Bjora Marches]].

==Stats==
: [[Slashing damage]]: 9-41 (Requires 9 [[Scythe Mastery]])
: [[Damage]] +15% 
: [[Energy]] -5
: [[Armor penetration]] +20% (20% chance)
: [[Enchantments]] last 20% longer
: Two-handed

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Insectoid Scythe]] colored a vivid green.
